description: This file defines the 'GenericEngine' interface within the 'org.apache.ofbiz.service.engine' package, outlining methods for executing services synchronously and asynchronously, handling callbacks, and managing service contexts.

classes.name: GenericEngine
classes.description: Interface for a generic service engine that provides methods for executing services both synchronously and asynchronously, including callback handling.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result as a Map.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously but ignores the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes a service asynchronously, passing a requester to receive the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes a service asynchronously without expecting a result.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Handles sending callbacks after service execution, with variants for success, failure, and different contexts.
